task_title: E1 Generalize scoped and run-global achievements

plan_review.notes: Addressed plan-review findings by (1) enforcing global achievement-id uniqueness across floor catalogs, (2) constraining current_run rules to run-global-safe facts at parse-time, (3) introducing shared finalizeFloorAchievementProgressOnExit ordering helper (evaluate run_end then snapshot once), and (4) adding contract-protection tests for scope defaulting, current_run fact restrictions, and floor2 stair snapshot behavior.
